opening.argument: The drink interaction is a drive-through conversation about an apparent order mismatch: the speaker says, “No, no, no That wasn't my order,” then acknowledges uncertainty and agrees to take it. A worker is shown handing a drink toward the vehicle. The speaker asks, “It's no charge?” Although the title and closing narration call the item a clever way to get free Starbucks, the available evidence does not establish a deceptive scheme or unauthorized transaction. The subscription request is routine channel promotion, not connected to the drink interaction or a financial offer.
